title: Morphisms to a finitely presented target factor through a finite stage
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $(D_i)_{i\in I}$ be a cofiltered inverse system [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and let $c:X\to\varprojlim_iD_i$ exhibit $X$ as its limit. If $Y\to S$ is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] and $a:X\to Y$ is an $S$-morphism, then there are an index $i$ and an $S$-morphism $b:D_i\to Y$ such that $a$ is the composite $X\to D_i\xrightarrow{b}Y$.
